name: masalahealth
description: Compare user-provided measurements with cited South Asian references from Open Masala and prepare questions for a clinician.

interface.shortDescription: Cited South Asian health references and appointment preparation
interface.longDescription: Use Open Masala to compare measurements with South Asian reference values, understand evidence limitations, and prepare questions for your clinician. Uses measurements you provide; does not retrieve your Masala app records.
defaultPrompt: Use MasalaHealth to compare the lab values I provide with South Asian references.
Use MasalaHealth to explain the evidence behind a South Asian reference range.
Use MasalaHealth to prepare questions for my next appointment.
